description: EXPLORATORY. Closes the arc's last gap: compIdx really counts components. CLOSED FORM -- with pi the closure permutation, pi i = i+1 when e_i is odd and pi i = pStart e i when even, so pi is the CYCLIC SHIFT on each compIdx class. Both inclusions follow (pi preserves compIdx, so a cycle sits in one class; inside a class every step is odd, so a class sits in one cycle), and no cycle decomposition of a product of adjacent transpositions is needed. Five predictions, all holding on every monotone word measured. PREDICTION E IS THE LOAD-BEARING ONE: the Lean's posAfter recursion, transcribed here, reproduces the `perm` array of `analyse` EXACTLY -- entry for entry, not merely agreeing on components. That is what stands in for the one step this arc never formalises, that posAfter and compIdx MODEL a monotone closure: 'braid word' and 'closure' are not Lean objects anywhere in the arc, so that step is a definition, and a reimplementation agreeing only on components could agree by sharing an assumption. Scope (a) for the measurement; the Lean theorems are unconditional. Nothing wired.

the_closed_form.odd_run: pi i = i + 1; compIdx (i+1) = compIdx i because an odd run adds 0
the_closed_form.even_run: pi i = pStart e i; compIdx_pStart (proved in #6775) puts it in the same class, and pStart is that class's least element
the_closed_form.consequence: pi is the cyclic shift on each compIdx class, so cycles = classes -- which is what compIdx was assumed to compute
the_closed_form.what_it_replaces: the cycle decomposition of a product of ascending adjacent transpositions, which is not needed

why_prediction_E_is_the_load_bearing_one.the_gap_it_covers: that posAfter and compIdx MODEL a monotone braid closure. 'Braid word' and 'closure' are not Lean objects anywhere in this arc, so that step is a definition, not a theorem
why_prediction_E_is_the_load_bearing_one.why_agreeing_on_components_would_be_weak: a separate reimplementation could agree on the component partition by sharing an assumption with the argument; agreeing on the permutation ARRAY, entry for entry, cannot
why_prediction_E_is_the_load_bearing_one.what_is_compared: the Lean recursion transcribed line for line, against the `perm` array built by `analyse` -- the routine every other number in this arc came from

what_the_arc_now_has.chain: posAfter models the word's positions (MonotoneWordPositionTracking) -> compIdx counts its components (MonotoneWordCycleStructure) -> tier 1 of eps_eq (MonotoneWordComponentStructure) -> eps_eq (EpsEqFromMonotonicity) -> mubar = 0 on every triple of the derived carrier (OneSeparatedComponentSuffices..., ChainTripleMilnor...)
what_the_arc_now_has.remaining_floor: the modelling step itself, measured not proved, and named as such in every file of the chain
